name: Little Summoner, Big Power

start.dialog: I'm a summoner too! Just like Yuna! But I lost my horn... my summoning horn. It fell into the ravine when I was playing. Can you help me find it? Please?
start.objective: Search the ravine for Eiko's lost summoning horn

progress.dialog: My horn is special. Made from a unicorn's... well, you know. It lets me call Maduin!
progress.objective: Continue searching the ravine and surrounding area

complete.dialog: You found it! My horn! Now I can summon again! Thank you! Here - I made you a charm. It has a little bit of Maduin's power in it. It'll keep you safe!

party_comments.kade: She's so young to be dealing with such power.
party_comments.vex: Youth is no barrier to faith. She is strong.
party_comments.renna: Her potential is remarkable. She will be powerful one day.

hidden_outcome: If you find the horn AND a 'Mog's Amulet' nearby, Eiko can summon Madeen and gives you the 'Holy Judgment' ability
